get.description: Retrieve an activity using it's uniques identifier,

put.description:
Completely updates an activity. If its position changes, the other
activities in the quest are reordered automatically. The activity
type cannot be changed; it must be deleted and recreated instead.

delete.description:
Deletes an activity and all ActivityUser progress records associated
with it in a single transaction. Remaining activities are reordered
to keep their positions consecutive.

204.description: Activity and related user progress deleted successfully

get.description: Retrieves the public quest catalog.

post.description: Creates a new quest with all neccesary information.

post.summary: Assign a quest to a user
post.description:
Creates a quest assignment with IN_PROGRESS status and zero progress.
It also creates an ActivityUser with zero progress for each activity
belonging to the assigned quest.

201.description: Quest and its activity assignments created successfully

422.description: Quest is not ready to complete

get.description: Returns every friend request with its state, or only the ones a user sent or received when user_id is sent.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Id of the user who sent or received the requests

post.description: Sends a friend request from the authenticated user to another user. A request cannot be sent to oneself or repeated while one is pending or accepted; after a rejection it can be sent again once 7 days have passed.

409.description: A request already exists between the users

example.message: There is already a friend request between you and this user.

422.description: The request is to oneself or was rejected less than 7 days ago

get.description: Returns the members of every family, or only the membership of one user when user_id is sent.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Id of the user whose membership is requested

post.summary: Add a member to a family
post.description: Adds a user to the family with the given role. Only a parent of that family can do it, and the user must not belong to another family.

403.description: The requester is not a parent of the family

example.message: Only a parent of the family can manage its members.

404.description: The family or the user does not exist

409.description: The user already belongs to a family

get.description: Returns every family with its members.

post.description: Creates a family whose first member is the authenticated user, with the PARENT role. Only users registered as parents can create one, and a user can belong to one family at a time.

409.description: The user already belongs to a family

example.message: The user already belongs to a family.

422.description: The user is not registered as a parent

example.message: Only a parent can create a family.

post.description:
Creates a pending collaborative session for a collaborative quest.
The session starts with null startedAt and completedAt dates.

post.summary: Invite a user to a collaborative quest session
post.description:
Creates a pending participant member invitation.
The invited user must be an accepted friend or family member.

post.summary: Verify the email and create the account
post.description: Checks the code sent by email. The code is valid for 20 minutes, can be used once and allows up to 5 attempts. When it is correct the account is created.

409.description: The email was registered in the meantime

422.description: The code is wrong, expired or has too many attempts

example.message: The verification code is not valid.

post.description: Stores the registration as pending and sends a six-digit verification code to the email address. The account is created only after the email is verified. Submitting again for the same email replaces the previous code.

400.description: Missing or invalid fields, or weak password

example.details: email: must be a well-formed email address

409.description: The email already has an account

example.message: This email address is already registered.

post.description: Validates the credentials and returns a signed access token. The error is the same whether the email or the password is wrong.

example.message: The email or password is incorrect.

post.description: Sends a recovery link to the email address when it belongs to an account. The response is the same for any email, so it does not reveal which ones are registered.
Consumes the token of the recovery link, which is valid for 30 minutes and can be used once, and replaces the password of the account.

example.message: The password must have 8 to 72 characters, with at least one letter and one digit.

422.description: The token is wrong, expired or already used

example.message: The recovery link is not valid or has expired.

post.description: Confirms the end of the session. Access tokens are stateless: the client must discard its token, which is not revoked on the server.

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

example.message: Authentication is required to access this resource.
